answer_markdown:
A bar chart has been generated showing average battery cycle counts across 4 device models in the fleet. ThinkPad X1 Carbon has the highest average cycle count at 489.0 cycles across 2 devices, followed by MacBook Air at 371.7 cycles across 3 devices, MacBook Pro at 202.0 cycles across 2 devices, and Dell XPS 15 at 128.0 cycles across 1 device.

queries.sql: SELECT model_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(battery_cycle_count) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_battery_cycles, COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM telemetry.v_latest_device_state WHERE battery_present = TRUE GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY avg_battery_cycles DESC LIMIT 50
